quote:
I contacted Lisa to do our family photos. Our group of 31 with all ages from grandparents to 2 years I knew would be a challenge. Lisa handled the photo shoot professionally and with so much patience. She made the process move along smoothly. She has a real eye for detail. The photos were amazing.

I ordered framed prints from her and she assisted me with everything and gave great suggestions to help with my choices. So accommodating to work. The finished prints are beautiful! I can’t wait to see them on my wall. I would recommend Lisa to anyone who wants quality professional photos.

Thank you Lisa.
name: Annette Christensen
imageAlt: A large extended family gathered outdoors beneath trees
